newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xiamen Int'l Bank to launch $40 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: China's Xiamen Int'l Bank to launch $40 mln FRCD.

text.p: Xiamen International Bank will launch a US$40 million floating-rate certificate of deposit issue on Wednesday, bankers said on Tuesday.
The issue has a final maturity of five years with a put option on the third anniversary.
Development Bank of Singapore, Banque Nationale de Paris's Hongkong branch, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp and DKB Asia are arranging for the deal.
Development Bank of Singapore and Banque Nationale de Paris's Hongkong branch are the bookrunners.
Xiamen International Bank is the first Sino-foreign joint venture bank established in China.

Its shareholders are Industrial and Commercial Bank of China's Fujian branch with 18.75 percent, Fujian Investment and Enterprise Corporation (12 percent), The Construction and Development Corporation of the Xiamen Special Economic Zone (7.5 percent), Min Xin Holdings (36.75 percent), Asian Development Bank (10 percent), Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan (10 percent) and Sino Finance Group (five percent).
